description: This file contains the implementation of the Bootstrap collapse component (version 2.0.4), including the Collapse class, plugin definition, and data-API for toggling collapsible elements.

classes.name: Collapse
classes.description: A class managing the collapse behavior of elements, including show, hide, toggle, and reset functionalities.

methods.name: dimension
methods.description: Determines whether the collapse uses width or height based on the element's classes.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Expands the collapsible element, handling active siblings and transition effects.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Collapses the element with transition effects.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the element's size to a specified value.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Handles the transition effect for show/hide actions.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles between show and hide states.
